{{Quote|Who dares summon me here and question my loyalty?|The Devaronian, to [[Durand's Council]]|<ref name="Paths" />}}
A '''Devaronian''' served as a [[captain]] to the [[Durand crime family]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. He was tried and executed for treason by [[Isa Durand]].<ref name="Paths" />

{{Char-stub}}
==Behind the scenes==
The captain first appeared in "[[Paths Unknown]],"<ref name="Paths" /> the second episode of the [[The Bad Batch Season 3|third season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'', which premiered on [[February 21]], [[2024]].<ref name="Watch">{{SW|url=news/the-bad-batch-season-3-trailer|text=Watch the ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 3 Trailer}}</ref> He was voiced by [[Liam O'Brien]].<ref name="Paths" /> Concept art of the captain was completed by [[Lucasfilm Animation]] artist [[Vivian Ly]].<ref name="Concept">{{SW|url=paths-unknown-concept-art-gallery-star-wars-the-bad-batch|text="Paths Unknown" Concept Art Gallery | The Bad Batch}} {{C|Slide 4}}</ref>
